title: Punch-Cutting Micro-Chiseling & Counter-Punch Metallurgy
discipline: Steel Punch-Cutting Mechanics · Counter-Punch Cold-Displacement · Tool Steel Metallurgy & Tempering · 3D Negative Space Sculpture
hypothesis: Can digital typography simulate the 3D metallurgical sculpture of 16th-century steel punch-cutting (governed by plastic shear flow τ = σ_y / √3 of annealed steel blanks, counter-punch cold-displacement, and oxidation temper-color metallurgy), demonstrating that designing letterforms by driving three-dimensional negative counter-punches into tool steel creates intrinsically superior optical counter-space balance and family consistency compared to drawing flat outer vector contours?
